findings.value: An independent food and shopping market in Hackney, with restaurants and shops. Its own site also names King's Cross.

evidence.quote: Enjoy independent restaurants and unique retail in Hackney and King's Cross.

notes: Source: the venue's own home page (its meta description; the page has no visible review text). The .co.uk address returned an empty page, so it was not used. No press review found: WebSearch budget was used up before this run's searches. Not a music venue on the evidence found, so no music or crowd finding is proposed.
